constraints: Connectome routing remains authoritative for organ selection.
Backoff occurs only after a connectome-selected organ raises an explicitly allow-listed exception.
Retry still requires idempotency, justification, and a maximum of three FCA attempts.
Backoff multiplier is bounded to 1..4 and requires a positive base retry delay.
Each individual delay is capped at 60 seconds.
Terminal and undeclared exceptions do not sleep or retry.
